product_one_liner.value: Karbon is cloud-based practice management software for accounting firms that combines client management, email, tasks, invoicing and payments in one platform.
product_one_liner.notes: Karbon describes its accounting-firm audience and combined practice-management capabilities at https://karbonhq.com/solution/client-management.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page includes per-user pricing: https://karbonhq.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Karbon publishes customer stories for System Six and BKL: https://karbonhq.com/customer-stories/system-six and https://karbonhq.com/customer-stories/bkl. | named_customers.0: System Six is named in a Karbon customer story: https://karbonhq.com/customer-stories/system-six. | named_customers.1: BKL is named in a Karbon customer story: https://karbonhq.com/customer-stories/bkl.

employee_band.notes: Karbon's LinkedIn company profile lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/3795518.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters address explicitly lists San Francisco: https://www.gleif.org/lei/254900EY5JBDTPBGP417. | hq_country: The headquarters address lists country US: https://www.gleif.org/lei/254900EY5JBDTPBGP417.

founded_year.notes: Karbon explicitly states it was founded in 2014: http://karbonhq.com/resources/client-trust-report-2026-karbon.

eng_blog.notes: The readable company blog index at https://medium.com/@karbonhq shows product-release summaries, company viewpoints, partnerships and hiring announcements, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored implementation posts. Confidence is limited because this is an older company blog archive.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains multiple guides covering authentication, client retrieval, work creation and other API operations: https://developers.karbonhq.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live application page lists AI Operations Lead, a qualifying AI-titled role: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/karbon/jobs/6208899004.

model_provider.notes: Karbon explicitly says Azure OpenAI Service powers Karbon AI: https://karbonhq.com/feature/ai.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://karbonhq.com/security claims SOC 2 Type II certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is self-assessed, not an independent certification. ISO 27001 is explicitly not yet independently certified; PCI DSS statements concern Stripe rather than Karbon's own certification. | compliance_certs.0: Karbon directly claims SOC 2 Type 2 certification on https://karbonhq.com/security. | compliance_certs.1: Karbon claims GDPR compliance through self-assessment, not independent certification: https://karbonhq.com/security.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest financing is classified as Later Stage VC, Series B: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/154034-11. | funding_date: The latest financing date is July 17, 2024, normalized to 2024-07: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/154034-11. | funding_amount_usd: The company profile identifies the last financing size as USD 10.5 million, equivalent to $10,500,000: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/154034-11.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded financing is July 17, 2024, before the eighteen-month window beginning May 9, 2025: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/154034-11. This negative relies on the funding database's latest-financing record.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive, SMB posting meets the requested sales-role criterion: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/karbon/jobs/6102022004.

launched_6mo.notes: Karbon introduced Kai, an AI coworker embedded in its platform, on June 3, 2026, within the six-month window: https://karbonhq.com/resources/karbon-launches-kai.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Karbon announced Brooke Brockman's appointment as CMO on November 11, 2025, within the requested twelve-month window: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/11/3185458/0/en/Karbon-Appoints-Brooke-Brockman-as-CMO-to-Lead-Global-Brand-Growth-and-AI-Innovation-for-Accounting-Firms.html.
